title: Manual bg entries not added as a treatment in NS
symptom: xDrip+ only submits a mbg entry to nightscout on upload and not a treatment entry. If you enter a BG via nightscout care portal, it creates both a mbg entry and a treatment entry. This is important if you want to see your BGs (entered from xDrip+) on the nightscout treatment report.
cause: NightscoutUploader.java only sends BGs to nightscout as entries, not as treatments.
evidence_quote: Looking at the code - NightscoutUploader.java only sends BGs to nightscout as entries. The requested change would send the (meter) BG values to nightscout as treatments as well.
